Krishna Kumar, J., Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

This appeal by the husband is directed against the impugned Judgment and Decree dated 30.7.2022 passed in M.C.No.55/2022 by the Principal Judge, Family Court, Koppal, whereby the said petition filed by the respondent/wife seeking dissolution of her marriage solemnized with the appellant on 22.11.2019 by a decree of divorce under Section 13(1)(ia) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 was decreed in favour of respondent/wife against appellant/husband.
2. When the matter came up for hearing, a Joint-Memo is filed by the parties reporting the amicable settlement arrived between them.

The Joint-memo reads as under:
"Joint memo In this the above named appellant and Respondent jointly beg to submit Joint Memo as under:
1.

The appellant and Respondent have decided to file this Joint Memo on the following terms and conditions:
a) The marriage between the appellant and respondent is admitted and there are no issues out of the marriage or at the time of parting of each other, the respondent was not conceived.

NC: 2023:KHC-D:10786-DB b) The respondent and appellant are hereby agreed to withdraw all the allegations unconditionally made against each other and their family and also agreed to withdraw the following cases unconditionally.
i) C.C. No. 1014/2022 Principal Civil Judge and J.M.F.C. at Koppal.

entities.text: Principal Civil Judge and J.M.F.C. at Koppal
entities.label: COURT

2
ii) Cr. Misc.No.437/2022 Principal Civil Judge and J.M.F.C. at Koppal.
iv) M.C.No.55/2022 Principal Family Court at Koppal disposed on 30-07-2022.
v) Petition filed before CDPO, Koppal.
vi) Criminal Complaint filed before the Women Police Station, Koppal in Crime No.74/2021 under Sections 498A, 504, 506 r/w 34 of I.P.C and sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
c) Both the parties hereby in unequivocal terms state that, all the allegations levelled against each other unconditionally withdrawn.
Hence no party will initiate any legal action basing such allegations in future.

2. The marriage between the Appellant and Respondent is dissolved by the decree of divorce as per the judgment and decree passed in M.C.No.55/2022 be modified and the marriage of appellant and respondent solemnized on 22-11-2019 at Haveri is dissolved by mutual consent.
The appellant and respondent are absolved from the matrimonial obligations and they are free to enter into marriage with the third person.
4. There are no claims against each other regarding household articles, gold and silver ornaments etc., to be exchanged between the appellant and respondent.
5. The respondent wife has given up her claim from present and future maintenance from the appellant.
The respondent will not demand any moveable or immovable property from the appellant or his parents.
6. The respondent and appellant hereby agree to give up all the future claims if any as against each other.
7. The parties hereby declare that there are no other cases than the above mentioned ones.

8. The respondent-wife hereby agrees to unconditionally withdraw CR.Misc.No.437/2022 pending on the file of Principal Civil Judge and J.M.F.C at Koppal and co-operate for disposal of C.C.No.1014/2022 along with Women Police Station, Koppal Crime No.74/2021 registered on 26-11-2021.

The respondent wife has agreed to withdraw all criminal cases filed against appellant and his family members and agreed to cooperate for the disposal of Crl. Pt. no.102348/2022 and 100081/2022 filed by the appellant and his family members, within 15 days from today.

9. In view of joint memo filed by both the parties, the judgment and decree passed in M.C.55/2022 may be modified and the marriage of appellant and respondent NC: 2023:KHC-D:10786-DB solemnized on 22-11-2019 at Rajani Convention Hall, Haveri is dissolved by mutual consent Sri Lohit Margoor S/O Channabasappa ... vs Smt. Shruthi Chavadi W/O. Lohit Margoor on 15 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64560466/
3 10.
Both the parties have submitted the joint memo with free will and volition."
3. Both parties are physically present before the Court have been identified by their respective counsel and admitted the execution of the Joint Memo.
Joint Memo is placed on record.

In The result, we pass the following :
ORDER (I) Appeal is hereby allowed.

(II) The impugned Judgment and Decree dated 30.07.2022 passed in MC.No.55/2022 passed by the Principal Judge, Family Court, Koppal is hereby set aside and M.C.No.55/2022 stands disposed of in terms of the Joint Memo.
(III) The marriage solemnized between the appellant and respondent on 22.11.2019 stands dissolved by a decree of divorce.
(IV) As agreed between the parties, the respondent agrees to withdraw the criminal proceedings that are pending before Courts in terms of the Joint Memo filed before this Court.
(V) Both parties have withdrawn the allegations and NC: 2023:KHC-D:10786-DB counter allegations made against each other for the purpose of amicable settlement.
 (VI) Draw Decree accordingly.
 Sd/-
